content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

When you think about selling digital products, you might assume that options like Gumroad, Teachable, or Stripe are your only choices. But each of these platforms has its own limitations and trade-offs. Gumroad, for example, charges a transaction fee of up to 8.5% for digital sales, and it requires you to have a PayPal account, which can be restricted in certain countries. Teachable is a popular platform for online courses, but it charges a monthly fee of $29, and it takes a commission of 0% to 5% on course sales. Stripe is a payment processor that's available in 46 countries, but it's not available in many countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. So what's the alternative? That's where sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in, with products like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which gives you a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, most digital platforms rely on complex workarounds or hacks to try to make them work. But these solutions are often fragile, unreliable, and prone to failure. COREMERCH, on the other hand, takes a different approach. Our sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be country-independent, so you can sell your digital products and services without worrying about platform restrictions. We achieve this through a combination of innovative technologies, like Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and strategic partnerships with payment processors like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has no transaction fees. With COREMERCH, you can sell your digital products and services without worrying about platform restrictions or limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed, fees, and real costs are critical factors to consider. Most digital platforms charge high transaction fees, which can eat into your profits and make it difficult to scale your business. COREMERCH, on the other hand, offers a much more efficient and cost-effective solution. Our payment processing is fast, reliable, and secure, with no transaction fees or hidden costs. We also support a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin, which can help you save money on transaction fees and reduce your reliance on traditional payment processors.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When you sell digital products and services, ownership, automation, and delivery are critical factors to consider. Most digital platforms require you to give up ownership of your data and intellectual property, which can make it difficult to scale your business and build a sustainable online presence. COREMERCH, on the other hand, empowers you to maintain full ownership and control over your data and intellectual property. We also offer automated delivery and payment processing, so you can focus on creating and marketing your digital products and services, rather than worrying about the underlying infrastructure. With COREMERCH, you can automate your online business and scale your operations with confidence.
